pages.headline: NavIC loses another atomic clock
pages.what: The last working atomic clock on IRNSS-1F failed, leaving few satellites able to give position and timing. NVS-02 had also failed to reach its orbit after a pyro-valve failure.
key: At least four working clocks needed
Coverage up to about 1,500 km beyond India
SPS on L5 and S bands, better than 20 m
pages.static: NavIC was approved in 2006; it is complemented by GAGAN for aviation.
pages.angle: Trap: assigning L1 to the first-generation SPS.

pages.headline: ESA loses contact with a Proba-3 spacecraft
pages.what: One of the two Proba-3 spacecraft went silent. The mission creates artificial eclipses to image the corona.
pages.static: ISRO's Aditya-L1 studies the Sun from the Sun-Earth L1 point.

pages.headline: DART changed the whole asteroid pair's orbit
pages.what: A study found DART altered the orbit of the Didymos pair around the Sun, not only Dimorphos' orbit.
key: Study: whole pair's solar orbit changed
pages.static: Planetary defence tests aim to deflect hazardous near-Earth objects.
pages.angle: Trap: naming the primary as the target.

pages.headline: MeerKAT finds brightest, most distant megamaser
pages.what: Using South Africa's MeerKAT telescope, astronomers found the brightest and most distant megamaser. It is a giant microwave beam from colliding galaxies, where compressed gas excites hydroxyl molecules. Such sources help study early galaxies.
key: Precursor to the Square Kilometre Array
Megamaser: microwave beam from merging galaxies
Gas clouds compressed, hydroxyl molecules excited
Masers amplify microwaves; lasers amplify visible light
pages.static: MASER stands for microwave amplification by stimulated emission of radiation.
pages.remember: MeerKAT: South Africa, SKA precursor, megamaser.

pages.headline: LHC finds the Xi-cc-plus
pages.what: LHCb discovered the Xi-cc-plus, a heavy baryon with two charm quarks and a down quark.
key: Two charm quarks plus one down quark
About four times a proton's mass
Second baryon with two heavy quarks
pages.static: Hadrons are baryons (three quarks) and mesons (quark-antiquark).

pages.headline: 23 institutions get quantum teaching labs
pages.what: DST cleared 23 institutions for quantum teaching labs under the NQM, with over 100 more proposals under evaluation.
pages.static: Quantum technologies include computing, communication, sensing and metrology.

pages.headline: Accelerator for thorium programme at Visakhapatnam
pages.what: RRCAT will build a high-energy proton accelerator at Visakhapatnam for Accelerator-Driven Systems.
key: India holds about 25 per cent of world thorium
pages.static: Bhabha's three stages: PHWR, fast breeder, thorium-based.

pages.headline: LIGO-India delayed to 2030
pages.what: Officials said LIGO-India at Hingoli will be completed by 2030.
pages.static: Gravitational waves were first detected by LIGO in 2015.
pages.angle: Trap: assuming Pune hosts the detector.

pages.headline: Rare-earth magnet scheme and pilot plant
pages.what: MHI invited bids for 6,000 MTPA of integrated sintered REPM capacity, while ARCI Hyderabad set up an Nd-Fe-B pilot plant.
key: Five beneficiaries, up to 1,200 MTPA each
pages.static: Rare earths are critical minerals; REPM is a strategic supply-chain item.

pages.headline: Nationwide HPV vaccination drive
pages.what: Girls aged 14 get free HPV shots at government facilities to prevent cervical cancer. U-WIN and eVIN support the campaign.
key: U-WIN and eVIN used; Gavi supplying doses
pages.static: Cervical cancer is the only cancer preventable by vaccine.

pages.headline: GARBH-INi aims at AI tools for preterm birth
pages.what: The 12,000-woman cohort supports indigenous AI solutions for preterm births.
pages.static: THSTI is a DBT institute.

pages.headline: CALM-Brain launched
pages.what: India's first open-source brain data repository for psychiatric disorders was launched in Bengaluru.
key: Funded by DBT and Pratiksha Trust
pages.static: NIMHANS is an Institute of National Importance.

pages.headline: Fortified rice paused under PMGKAY
pages.what: After a study found nutrient losses in storage, the Centre paused fortified rice supply.
key: PDS, ICDS, PM Poshan grains continue
pages.static: FSSAI's 2018 fortification regulation covers rice, wheat flour, edible oil, milk and salt.
pages.angle: Trap: mixing biofortification with industrial fortification.
pages.remember: Bio-fortify the crop; industrial fortify the food.

pages.headline: World Obesity Atlas puts India second
pages.what: India has about 41 million school-age children with high BMI, second after China.
key: 20.7 per cent of children 5-19 overweight or obese globally
pages.static: BMI is weight in kg divided by height in metres squared.

pages.headline: GLP-1 advertising barred
pages.what: CDSCO banned advertising of GLP-1 drugs due to misuse.
pages.static: CDSCO is India's national drug regulator under the Ministry of Health.
pages.angle: Trap: treating mechanism as the reason.

pages.headline: India's data centre boom and its limits
pages.what: Capacity quadrupled in five years, helped by Budget 2026-27 incentives.
key: Tax holiday till 2047 for cloud exporters
Up to 2 million litres water a day per 100 MW
Over 70 per cent in four hubs
pages.static: DPDP Act, 2023 and RBI data localisation shape data policy.

pages.headline: Panel flags IndiaAI Mission underspend
pages.what: The Mission's underutilisation led to a halved Budget allocation.
key: 32 per cent of RE used by December 2025
pages.static: IndiaAI Mission is run by MeitY.

pages.headline: IISc's brain co-processor Moonshot
pages.what: The project builds co-processors for stroke rehabilitation.
key: Pilot under Brain, Computation and Data Science initiative
pages.static: BCIs read neural signals; co-processors also write back.

pages.headline: DHRUV64: indigenous 64-bit microprocessor launched
pages.what: C-DAC launched DHRUV64, a fully indigenous 64-bit microprocessor for 5G, IoT and industrial automation. It forms part of India's push for native processors, which also includes SHAKTI and VIKRAM under the Microprocessor Development Programme and DIR-V.
key: Part of Microprocessor Development Programme and DIR-V
pages.static: C-DAC, headquartered at Pune, is a scientific society under the Ministry of Electronics and IT.

pages.headline: Dual-use technologies and the dual-use dilemma
pages.what: Advances in nuclear science, AI, biotechnology and space systems have widened dual-use technologies, which serve civilian needs but can be turned to military or malicious ends. Conflicts show GPS jamming, cyber-attacks and commercial satellites blurring the line.
key: Civilian use with potential military or malicious use
Now spans AI, biotech, cyber, additive manufacturing, space
Non-kinetic tools: GPS jamming and spoofing, cyber-attacks
India joined the Wassenaar Arrangement in 2017
pages.static: SCOMET stands for Special Chemicals, Organisms, Materials, Equipment and Technologies; DGFT notifies it.
pages.angle: Trap: crediting the Defence Ministry with SCOMET.
pages.remember: Dual-use: civil and military; SCOMET via DGFT.

pages.headline: Indore EV fire and thermal runaway
pages.what: The Indore EV fire raised concern over lithium-ion batteries. A Battery Management System normally keeps them safe, but thermal runaway, where one hot cell sets off its neighbours, can cause intense fires that are hard to extinguish.
key: Battery Management System regulates temperature, voltage, charging
Thermal runaway: chain overheating of cells
Triggers: damage, overcharging, defects, heat, flooding
EV battery fires burn hotter and are harder to put out
Indore toll worsened by LPG cylinders and door-lock failure
pages.static: Solid-state batteries, which use solid electrolytes, are being developed to cut leakage and runaway risk.
pages.angle: Trap: calling EV fires easier to extinguish.
pages.remember: Thermal runaway: hotter, faster, harder to douse.

pages.headline: Indigenous floating LiDAR buoy tested
pages.what: Offshore wind resource measurement tool tested off Tamil Nadu.
pages.static: Offshore wind needs resource data before project siting.

pages.headline: OTEC plant for Kavaratti
pages.what: Integrated OTEC plant planned in Lakshadweep.
pages.static: OTEC is a marine renewable.
pages.angle: Trap: assuming OTEC works only in daylight.

pages.headline: Dark oxygen reported
pages.what: Deep-sea oxygen without light.
pages.static: Polymetallic nodules are key deep-sea mining targets.

pages.headline: CSIR-NCL develops DME production technology
pages.what: CSIR-National Chemical Laboratory developed a dimethyl ether production process. DME is a clean-burning second-generation fuel that can be blended with LPG up to about 20 per cent and made from Indian coal, methanol or captured CO2.
key: Can be blended with LPG up to about 20 per cent
Made from coal, methanol or captured CO2
Burns with minimal SOx, NOx, soot and particulates
pages.static: CSIR-NCL is a Pune-based national laboratory under the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research.
pages.remember: DME: LPG substitute from coal, methanol or CO2.
